clauses.title: Scope – Cover the
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Cover the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium channels  for structural use and other  applications.

clauses.title: Designation –  Aluminium channels shall be
clauses.text: 2. Designation -  Aluminium channels shall be designated as ALC followed by the depth of channel in mm, flange width in mm and mass of the section in kg/m, Example : ALC 80 × 40 - 3. 21

clauses.title: Aluminium sections covered in
clauses.text: 3.1 Aluminium sections covered in this standard shall be manufactured from the following alloys in appropriate temper : 19000,  24345,  24534,  52000,  53000,  63400,  64423, 64430, 65032 and 74530.

clauses.title: Aluminium
clauses.text: 3.2 Aluminium  alloys   and temper  selected shall conform to the provisions of  IS 733 : 1983* * Wrought aluminium  and aluminium alloy  bars rods and  sections for general engineering purposes  (third revision)

clauses.title: Designation and size
clauses.text: 4.1 Designation and size Note — For  sectional properties, refer to Table of the standard, Dimensional tolerances for the sections shall be as specified in IS 3965 :1981+ + Dimensions for wrought aluminium and aluminium  alloy bars rods and section (first revision).
